g.text: TARGETS: MAC • WINDOWS • LINUX • KAGGLE T4
See what runs on your Mac, laptop, or desktop before downloading.
Tested on real hardware with engine overhead and thermal throttles.
Why? GPU power state, real laptop memory clocks, and engine overhead.
No local GPU? Free Kaggle notebook submitted 112 tok/s on T4.
CORE TAKEAWAY: "Can I run it?" calculators guess.
RunsOnMine tests real software stacks on real silicon before you download.
Max Speed <= Memory Bandwidth / Model Size
Speeds exceeding theoretical DRAM bandwidth rejected automatically.
Battery runs, thermal throttles, or CPU offload quarantined from "best".
No usernames, IPs, filepaths, prompts, or model output ever collected.
SUBMISSION FORMAT: JSON with content hash
Includes GPU clock, power (W), AC status, driver version, token latency.
